The Haven Upholstered Headboard is for anyone who wants a calm, inviting bedroom. Its clean, softly padded design suits contemporary and classic rooms, and it is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Clean, softly padded design
  • Soft-touch fabric for comfort when you sit up to read or relax
  • Wall-mounted or attached to a divan base
  • Five UK sizes, with made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a wooden frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Can I fit the Haven headboard to a divan base?

Yes. It can be wall-mounted or attached to a divan base.

Is it made to measure?

Made-to-measure options are available on request. Call 07417 439197 or email us to discuss.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Hilton Wingback Bed is a traditional upholstered bed frame for anyone who wants a bed with real style, substance and a sense of heritage. Subtly curved winged head and footboards frame the pillows, and it is handmade to order in West Yorkshire in every UK size.

Key features

  • Ornate curved winged headboard and footboard
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Wooden frame construction
  • Available in all five UK bed sizes
  • Free fabric swatches before you buy
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes

Size Mattress (UK standard) Price
Single (3FT) 90 x 190cm £337.99
Small Double (4FT) 120 x 190cm £363.99
Standard Double (4FT6) 135 x 190cm £376.99
King (5FT) 150 x 200cm £402.99
Super King (6FT) 180 x 200cm £480.99

Measure the wall the bed will sit against, then leave at least 60cm walking space at one side. Check ceiling slopes and low windows before choosing a tall winged headboard.

Materials & build

  • Wooden frame
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, with custom fabric and colour options available on request
  • Handmade to order in our workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire

Delivery & assembly

Free delivery across Great Britain by our own Eagle Bed team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Want it built for you? Add room-of-choice assembly for £69.99 when you order.

Questions about access, stairs or setting up? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com before you order and we will help.

Warranty & payment

Every bed is backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout, and order free fabric swatches if you would like to see the colours in person first.

Buying guide

What is a wingback bed?

A wingback bed is an upholstered bed frame with tall side panels (wings) angling forward from the headboard, framing the pillows and blocking draughts. The Hilton Wingback has subtly curved winged head and footboards, handmade in West Yorkshire in Single 3ft to Super King 6ft, from £337.99.

Wingback bed vs winged headboard

A winged headboard is the board alone. A wingback bed is the complete frame — headboard, footboard and side rails upholstered to match, so the wings and the base share the same fabric and finish.

Eagle Bed builds both on a wooden frame, with a 5-year frame warranty and free delivery across Great Britain. If you already own a base, a headboard alone is enough; if you want the whole look, the Hilton Wingback is the full frame.

Wingback, panel or storage?

Wingback — this bed. Tall forward-angled wings for a traditional, enclosed look. From £337.99.

Vertical panel — straight clean lines, no wings: Eagle Mayfair Panel Bed from £311.99.

Wingback with storage — the winged shape on a divan base with drawers: Oxford Wingback Storage Bed from £259.99, or a full gas lift ottoman base from £220.99 (end-lift) and £249.99 (side-lift).

You're viewing: a wingback upholstered frame with no built-in storage.

Pair it with our 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99) or the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99). Browse all Eagle Bed frames.

FAQ

Does the Hilton Wingback have storage?

No. It is a wingback upholstered frame with no built-in storage. For storage, see the Oxford Wingback Storage Bed or our gas lift ottoman bases linked above.

Where is the Hilton Wingback Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Order free fabric swatches first, or call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com for advice on colours.

Reviews

Eagle Bed is a small West Yorkshire workshop and we only publish reviews from verified buyers — so you'll see real ones here as they come in, good and bad. There are no reviews of the Hilton Wingback Bed yet, and we will not show a star rating until there are. Bought this bed? Leave a review using the review form below. Not sure yet? Order free fabric swatches or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com and we'll answer honestly. Read our review policy.

Written by the Eagle Bed workshop team. Last updated 30 September 2026. Prices as of 30 September 2026.

The Horizontal Channel Kids Bed has evenly spaced horizontal channels across the headboard. The look is calmer and more linear than our fan or panel designs, and the bed is fully upholstered and handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Evenly spaced horizontal channel headboard
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard

  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. Not sure which size or mattress to choose? Call 07417 439197 before you order, or browse our mattresses.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid, sturdy wood frame that is fully upholstered. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
